paras: DO NOT: Treat inner voices, images, movements or body signals as commands or proof. Listen, then always reality test them.

fixes.what: don't treat them as commands or proof (not: don't see them as real); listen, then reality-test
fixes.replace: See the voices, images, movements or body signals as real, but always reality test them.
fixes.with: Treat inner voices, images, movements or body signals as commands or proof. Listen, then always reality test them.

paras: DO NOT obsess about “downloading” grandiose information or become obsessed with demons, jinn, “Unattached Burdens”, etc. Stabilize yourself. Get help if necessary, especially if not reality testing well or if not functioning well in life.
DO NOT do self-hypnosis while driving a car, bathing, swimming, operating equipment, supervising children, or otherwise doing something that requires active attention.

fixes.with: swimming, operating equipment, supervising children, or otherwise

paras: DO NOT try to “force” memories to “prove” something to yourself or ignore medical symptoms by “forcing” them down through hypnosis.
DO NOT “force” yourself to ignore basic body signals, like hunger, tiredness, pain, etc., or basic emotions, like grief, anger, fear, etc., before you understand what the signal is saying.

fixes.with: like grief, anger, fear, etc., before you understand what the signal is saying.

paras: DO NOT “extend” altered states indefinitely or take intuitive hits as “real” without reality testing them.

DO NOT allow any inner state, like the “Inner Child” or “Protector” or “Nurturer” or “Leader” to take over completely. They each need the others: the child doesn’t run adult life, the Protector can’t shut out all love, the Nurturer can’t erase consequences, the Leader can’t skip over the child, and both analysis and tenderness stay available.

fixes.what: the proportions: the child doesn't lead adult life, the Protector can't exclude all love, the Nurturer can't erase consequences, the Leader can't bypass the child, analysis and tenderness both stay available
fixes.with: They each need the others: the child doesn’t run adult life, the Protector can’t shut out all love, the Nurturer can’t erase consequences, the Leader can’t skip over the child, and both analysis and tenderness stay available.

paras: DO NOT use NLP techniques to “force” down “protectors” or to manufacture certainty, manipulate people, or “heal” something when the body is saying no.

fixes.what: manufacturing certainty is lost, 'doesn't make logical sense' is new, and the body saying no isn't the same as 'cannot be healed'
fixes.replace: or to do anything else that does not make logical sense, like to manipulate people or to “heal” something that the body is saying cannot be healed.
fixes.with: or to manufacture certainty, manipulate people, or “heal” something when the body is saying no.

paras: Don’t convince yourself that negative indicators like doubt, distraction, resistance, or lack of response, or saying “No” are good indicators that the induction is working.
Don’t rely solely upon the “safety” of “the unconscious mind”. Always make certain you have clear limits, a safe setting, the ability to stop, and a way out you’ve tested.

fixes.what: clear limits, the ability to stop, a tested exit
fixes.replace: Always make certain that the circumstances are as safe as possible and that there is a safe way out.
fixes.with: Always make certain you have clear limits, a safe setting, the ability to stop, and a way out you’ve tested.

paras: Don’t believe that normal physical sensations prove hidden trauma, illness, body toxins, demonic possession, “attachments”, “transformations” or some hidden “subconscious” truth.

fixes.what: sensations don't prove these things (and 'subconscious truth' is one of them, not a condition)
the condition 'just because the subconscious says they are' is new
fixes.replace: or anything else, just because the “subconscious” says they are.

paras: Don’t believe that anything is “healed” physically or neurologically/cellularly, simply because it is “healed” in the imagination.

Don’t ever allow anyone to put hidden “commands” in. A cue you choose consciously to reuse should have a clear purpose, stay reviewable, and be removed if you no longer want it. Just saying “cancel” doesn’t guarantee it’s instantly erased. Don’t allow anyone to give commands to someone else to give to “YOU” or to make YOU do anything or change to a different person or have amnesia, etc.

fixes.what: the published bans hidden instructions; a consciously chosen reusable cue needs a clear purpose, stays reviewable and is retired when unwanted
fixes.replace: Don’t ever allow anyone to put “commands” in without giving them to yourself consciously and knowing why and wanting them, so that they can be used repeatedly and reviewed and removed if they are no longer wanted.
fixes.with: Don’t ever allow anyone to put hidden “commands” in. A cue you choose consciously to reuse should have a clear purpose, stay reviewable, and be removed if you no longer want it.

fixes.what: 'there is no way to put something in that cannot be removed' is a new reassurance; the published says only that 'cancel' doesn't guarantee instant erasure
fixes.replace: There is no way to “put something in” that cannot be removed, but saying “I remove them” may not be enough.
fixes.with: Just saying “cancel” doesn’t guarantee it’s instantly erased.

paras: DO bring yourself all the way back at the end of every waking session: yourself again, moving, oriented, with your judgment back, and say straight out that the session has ended.

fixes.what: movement, orientation, judgment, and a direct statement that the session has ended
fixes.replace: DO bring yourself back to normal consciousness as yourself at the end of each session while awake.
fixes.with: DO bring yourself all the way back at the end of every waking session: yourself again, moving, oriented, with your judgment back, and say straight out that the session has ended.
